## What this PR does



## Language sync (required if SKILL/README changes)

This repo enforces paired updates: if you change a skill's English folder
(e.g. `weekly-budget-report/`), you must also update the corresponding
variant folder (`weekly-budget-report-zh-TW/`), and vice versa. The
`i18n Sync Check` workflow will fail otherwise.

Tick one:

- [ ] Both language folders updated in this PR
- [ ] Single-language change is intentional — added label `i18n-sync-skip` and explained why above

## Checklist

- [ ] Tested manually (ran `/weekly-budget-report` or equivalent)
- [ ] No personal/private paths or budget numbers introduced
- [ ] Translation quality reviewed (if touching a variant folder)
